_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run. Under-covered-role target: Data Engineering (3 tagged opportunities entering this run, tied-thinnest with Help Desk/IT Support, Network Engineering, QA/Test Engineering, Security/InfoSec; last run's own recommendation was to rotate here). Dedicated searches on data-engineer role content, CDO/CDAO reorganization, and data-engineering skills demand surfaced only vendor job-posting material (reliability 1-2, excluded) and CDO-governance commentary that restates rather than extends the existing data-foundation-investment-differentiates-ai-success opportunity -- nothing cleared the bar for a new, distinctly-evidenced opportunity, so Data Engineering stays at 3 by design (gaps closed only with real evidence, never generous tagging). Census BTOS (mandatory every run) was searched; no new admission (consecutiveEmptyRuns 2->3). Four opportunities updated with new evidence this run: `agentic-ai-governance-outpaces-readiness` added a third Deloitte survey (501 leaders: only 21% rate business processes agentic-AI-ready, 46% even among scaled adopters) and a November 2026 Gartner I&O survey (57% call AI governance weak, predicts 40% of I&O orgs scaling AI will suffer disruption by 2028) -- both institutions already in the trail, so breadth stays at ceiling (5) and evidenceScore stays 4. `help-desk-tiered-support-flattens-agentic-automation` added a follow-up Gartner survey wave (21% headcount reduction, 7% rehiring) and, via the mandatory red-team pass, its first structured contradictingEvidence entry: a Gartner prediction that 30% of AI-displaced workers will be rehired by 2029, which complicates the 'redeploy not eliminate' story but doesn't clear the reliability>=3 downgrade threshold -- opportunity is now contested:true with evidenceScore unchanged at 4. `ai-workforce-impact-slowly-rising-tide` added a Gartner net-jobs forecast (+1.7M worldwide by 2030) as a third independent institution and second tier, moving corroborationBreadth 3->4 with evidenceScore arithmetic still landing on 4. `genai-adoption-plateau-scaling-gap` added a 13th independent institution (Gartner HR survey: 77% of boards expect AI cost savings, only 3% of orgs actually exceed their cost-savings goals) with both axes already at ceiling (evidenceScore stays 5); also corrected a stale 'ten institutions' count in its summary prose to thirteen. One candidate finding (an arXiv paper surfaced only via a WebSearch synthesis, claimed ID 2611.17530) could not be independently verified -- arxiv.org is not reachable via WebFetch in this session's network policy -- and was not admitted; flagged for a future run with arXiv access. Broad rotation search covered BLS, Federal Reserve Board and six regional banks, Gartner, Forrester, IDC, McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte, PwC, Accenture, NBER, HBR, OECD, WEF, SSRN, and arXiv. Red-teamed all thirteen evidenceScore>=4 opportunities (lastRedTeamedDate 2026-11-16); no reliability>=3 evidence reversed any thesis. No new opportunities founded; no opportunity archived (none aged out of the 12-month window). Sources at consecutiveEmptyRuns>=6 and climbing: OECD (11), Accenture Research (10), World Economic Forum (10), MIT CISR (9, no longer mandatory), PwC Research/Insights (6), EY Insights (6), IDC (6), MIT Sloan Management Review (6) -- none yet flagged as possibly dead. Gartner and Deloitte Insights both reset to consecutiveEmptyRuns:0 on genuine new admissible findings. See data/findings_log/2026-11-16.md for full detail. GitHub Pages mirror publish status recorded below once publish_pages.py and --verify complete.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
